title: Elite: Execute the Magistrate Verdict Court: Gate Verdict
description: Elite: Execute the Magistrate Verdict Court: Gate Verdict is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate (Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Lucifer, Lilith, Asmodeus, Naamah enters; this beat spotlights Naamah as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the boss step at Magistrate Verdict Court, using infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Infernal Dominion is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Black-Iron Debt Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Magistrate Verdict Court and reveals: How repeated mistakes become chains. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — The Gate Threshold. the epicenter where all seven realm-Gates converge on Earth, reality warping with overlapping faction energies, ground shifting between desert sand, marble, storm-iron, void-mist, shrine-lacquer, living-wood, and radiant light — the final battleground. Neutral ground — no faction advantage or penalty. The Gate has reshaped this terrain.
